info.name: Griot — API Contract Suite (REST + GraphQL)
info.description: Official Griot Postman collection. Covers every route in backend/project-kit/context/api-surface.md. Auth tokens (accessToken, refreshToken) and entity IDs chain automatically into the environment via Tests scripts. Reused headlessly as Newman in CI (qa spec 05). Implementation maturity per route is encoded in assertions: auth returns 200/201/204, module scaffold routes return 501 until their feature specs land.

request.description: Public health endpoint. No auth required. Contract: api-surface.md GET /health → 200 Healthy.
Register a new user account. Writes accessToken, refreshToken, and userId to the environment on success. Contract: auth-contract.md POST /register → 201.
Authenticate and receive a fresh token pair. Rotates refresh tokens. 429 with Retry-After after 10 attempts / 900s (Redis sliding window). Contract: auth-contract.md POST /login → 200.

request.description: Authenticated logout. Idempotent: malformed/unknown/revoked tokens still return 204. Contract: auth-contract.md POST /logout → 204.

Request a 6-digit email OTP. Auto-sent on register for email_verify purpose. Purposes: email_verify | login_2fa | password_reset. Rate-limited 3/900s per email. Contract: auth-contract.md POST /otp/request → 202.
